scientific_integrity: Proof uses an explicitly identified previously published homotopy interleaving upper-bound theorem; all new block-map and winding steps are supplied. Finite checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for cacti with no cycle longer than five; larger cycles yield a lower bound, not a complete phase diagram. Requires finite connected unit-edge simple cactus with at least two vertices. Unindexed equivalent priority remains possible; independently unvalidated.
title: A sharp pentagon threshold for the homotopy interleaving distance of cactus enriched nerves
